name: CareCloud, Inc.
business_overview: CareCloud, Inc., a healthcare information technology company, provides technology-enabled business solutions, Software-as-a-Service offerings, and related business services to healthcare providers and hospitals primarily in the United States. It operates through Healthcare IT and Medical Practice Management segments. The company's proprietary software and business services includes technology-enabled business solutions; cloud-based software; digital health services; healthcare IT professional services and staffing; MAP App; and medical practice management services. It also offers revenue cycle management services, healthcare claims clearinghouse, and medical coding and credentialing services; electronic health records, practice management software and related capabilities, patient experience management solutions, business intelligence and healthcare analytics platforms, and customized applications, interfaces, and various other technology solutions, as well as artificial intelligence, such as CareCloud cirrusAI, AI-powered clinical decision support, AI-powered virtual support assistant, AI-driven appeals, Stratus AI Desk Agent, and CareCloud cirrusAI. In addition, the company provides chronic care management, remote patient monitoring, and telemedicine solutions; professional services; managed services; workforce augmentation; on-demand staffing; and strategic advisory services. Further, it offers medical practice management services to medical practices comprising appropriate facilities, equipment, supplies, support services, nurses, and administrative support staff, as well as management, bill-paying, and financial advisory services. It serves physicians, nurses, nurse practitioners, therapists, physician assistants, and other clinicians that render bills for their services. The company was formerly known as MTBC, Inc. and changed its name to CareCloud, Inc. in March 2021. CareCloud, Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** CareCloud is in the midst of a durable operational turnaround, marked by consecutive quarters of profitability and its first full-year positive earnings since going public. The company has expanded beyond its ambulatory roots by entering the inpatient software market through acquisition, while launching a suite of generative AI products that position it for next-generation healthcare workflows. Revenue growth has been solid, and the firm exceeded its own full-year guidance, signaling healthy demand for its technology and revenue cycle management solutions. No material macro or regulatory headwinds are cited; the narrative reflects a business gaining competitive reach in a stable end-market.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership has been executing a disciplined turnaround, then taking decisive steps to simplify a complex capital structure by retiring preferred stock and securing a new credit facility. Management reaffirmed forward guidance immediately after these changes, underscoring confidence. The team is integrating the Medsphere inpatient platform while absorbing near-term cost headwinds without wavering on full-year targets. Credibility is reinforced by a long string of met or exceeded commitments, the launch of AI-driven offerings, and a clear pivot from balance-sheet cleanup toward growth.
